question: Who among the following is the writer of ‘Train to Pakistan’, ‘Good, Bad and Ridiculous’ and ‘Delhi: A Novel’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khushwant Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khushwant Singh** was a prominent Indian author, lawyer, diplomat, journalist, and politician.
 
• He is well-known for his novel **'Train to Pakistan'**, which is set against the backdrop of the Partition of India in 1947.
 
• His book **'Good, Bad and Ridiculous'** is a collection of essays offering a sharp and humorous take on various personalities and events.
 
• **'Delhi: A Novel'** by Khushwant Singh is a historical novel that explores the history of the city of Delhi through various periods and perspectives.
 
• Khushwant Singh was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in 1974, which he returned in 1984 to protest against the siege of the Golden Temple by the Indian Army.
 
• He was also honored with the **Padma Vibhushan** in 2007 for his contributions to literature and education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ruskin Bond**__

 __
 
• **Ruskin Bond** is an Indian author of British descent, known for his works of children's literature and his stories set in the hill stations of India.
 
• He has written several popular books, including **'The Room on the Roof'** and **'The Blue Umbrella'**.
 
• Bond has received the **Sahitya Akademi Award** and the **Padma Shri** for his contributions to literature.
 
 
 
• **Vikram Seth**__
 __
 
• **Vikram Seth** is an Indian novelist and poet, best known for his epic novel **'A Suitable Boy'**, which is one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume.
 
• His other notable works include **'An Equal Music'** and **'The Golden Gate'**.
 
• Seth has been awarded several literary honors, including the **Padma Shri** and the **Pravasi Bharatiya Samman**.
 
 
 
• **Amitav Ghosh**__
 
 
• **Amitav Ghosh** is an Indian writer known for his historical fiction and exploration of the themes of migration and displacement.
 
• His notable works include **'The Shadow Lines'**, **'The Glass Palace'**, and the **Ibis Trilogy**.
 
• Ghosh has received numerous awards, including the **Jnanpith Award** and the **Padma Shri**.
